title: Admin: settings page
interface:
Extends base.html. Title 'Nastavení'. Shows `problems` (list of str) in a div.flash.error when non-empty. Info box: 'Redirect URI pro registraci aplikace v Entra ID:' followed by {{ redirect_uri }}. One form POST /admin/settings containing, for each (group, rows) in `groups`, an

{{ group }}

and for each row a label {{ row.label }} with the input: type 'choice' -> ; 'json' or 'text' -> ; 'secret' rows -> ; others -> ; a {{ row.help }} under each. Submit button 'Uložit'. Below the form two separate forms: POST /admin/settings/test-email with button 'Odeslat testovací e-mail' and POST /admin/settings/hr-sync with button 'Synchronizovat zaměstnance z HR teď'. The page text must contain the words 'SMTP' and 'Entra'. Variables: groups, problems, redirect_uri, user. Czech.
